parentModel.compatibilityNote: CI2-T3 extends CI1-T4 without modifying it in place. The CI1-T4 historical model remains authoritative at its versioned path. CI2-T3 adds enforcement bindings, explicit field classification, and NR-11 alias vocabulary. It does not overwrite CI1-T4 facet definitions or normalization rules NR-01 through NR-10.

enforcedFields.description: Original source file or canonical imported path. Required in every classification ledger row.
Path normalized per CVF Corpus Path Normalization Algorithm. Root-relative, forward-slash separator, lowercase, no leading/trailing separator, no ./ or ../ segments, no Windows drive letters.
enforcedFields.enforcedBy: CI2-T2 NR-05 checker — structural canonical-form validation; does not validate path semantic meaning or resolve actual filesystem path
enforcedFields.ci1T4NormalizationRule: NR-05 (DEFER_CI1-T6 → STANDARD_REQUIRED_FIRST → standard authored by CSA1 → checker implemented by CI2-T2)

enforcedFields.description: SHA-256 of raw source file byte content, hex-encoded, lowercase. Proves per-file drift resistance. Packet-level exception: manifestHashProxy: true with non-empty manifestProxyException string of at least 20 characters is accepted in place of per-row sourceHash.
enforcedFields.enforcedBy: CI2-T2 NR-04 checker — structural presence and format gate; does not validate hash value accuracy or prove file content integrity
enforcedFields.ci1T4NormalizationRule: NR-04 (DEFER_CI1-T6 → STRUCTURAL_CHECK_REQUIRED → checker implemented by CI2-T2)

enforcedFields.description: Algorithm identifier for sourceHash. Default: sha256. Required only when a non-default algorithm is used. When omitted, reviewers assume SHA-256.
enforcedFields.enforcedBy: documentation convention; no dedicated machine check

enforcedFields.description: Primary per-row disposition. Allowed values: ACCEPT, ACCEPT_SUMMARY_ONLY, DEFER, REJECT, BLOCKED_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND, BLOCKED_UNREADABLE.
Original per-row disposition before canonical alias merge. Required whenever dispositionAlias is present. Preserves the author-assigned DEFER or ACCEPT_SUMMARY_ONLY value for traceability.
enforcedFields.enforcedBy: CI2-T2 NR-11 checker — structural alias discipline gate; does not validate semantic correctness of disposition assignments
enforcedFields.ci1T4NormalizationRule: NR-11 (new field added in CI2-T3; not present in CI1-T4 model)

enforcedFields.description: Canonical alias for cross-packet queries. Rows with DEFER or ACCEPT_SUMMARY_ONLY disposition MUST carry dispositionAlias: ACCEPT_DEFERRED. Enables cross-packet disposition queries without raw enum scatter.
enforcedFields.enforcedBy: CI2-T2 NR-11 checker — structural alias discipline gate
enforcedFields.ci1T4NormalizationRule: NR-11 (new field added in CI2-T3; not present in CI1-T4 model)

enforcedFields.description: How an agent may use this row to answer queries. Allowed values: DIRECT_CITED_ANSWER, SUMMARY_WITH_SOURCE, PROCEDURAL_GUIDANCE, ESCALATE_OR_ABSTAIN.
Section, line, paragraph, article, hash, or receipt reference that proves the classification claim for this row.
File processing status. Allowed values: READ_DEEP, READ_SHALLOW, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, DEFERRED, BLOCKED_UNREADABLE.
GC-050 or project-specific knowledge region label for routing and retrieval scoping.

Owner surface or consuming CVF plane. Prefer NR-03 enum vocabulary over runtime file references (e.g., PRIVATE_PROVENANCE, CONTROL_PLANE_CONTEXT_BUILDER, GOVERNANCE_LAYER, LEARNING_PLANE, ROADMAP_BACKLOG, CONTROL_PLANE_ADAPTERS).
enforcedFields.enforcedBy: NR-03 vocabulary convention; alias to runtime file reference accepted per CI1-T4; no dedicated checker
enforcedFields.gaps: Vocabulary conformance not machine-checked; alias remains accepted by NR-03 normalization note from CI1-T4

enforcedFields.description: Corpus root or import root. Should match a GC-051 registered corpus root for registered scan packets.
enforcedFields.enforcedBy: GC-051 corpus scan registry checker (for registered packets)

enforcedFields.description: Folder family, import batch, document collection, or project module. Use explicit kebab-case label matching GC-051 corpusId where applicable.
enforcedFields.enforcedBy: NR-10 editorial convention; not currently machine-checked
enforcedFields.gaps: Explicit kebab-case label not enforced by checker

enforcedFields.description: Document type. Allowed values: doc, source, policy, notice, roadmap, review, spec, SOP, contract, other. Alias 'Document type' accepted per NR-01.
enforcedFields.enforcedBy: NR-01 alias normalization; presence checked by GC-050; no dedicated value-vocabulary checker

enforcedFields.description: Controlled or reviewer-approved topic tags. Alias 'Domain' accepted per NR-02.
enforcedFields.enforcedBy: NR-02 alias normalization; no dedicated checker

enforcedFields.description: Per-file sensitivity. Allowed values: public, internal, confidential, restricted, unknown. Must be stated per-file, not corpus-level only.
enforcedFields.enforcedBy: NR-06 documentation guidance only per CI1-T6 DOCUMENTATION_ONLY verdict; no dedicated checker authorized
enforcedFields.gaps: Per-file declaration not machine-checked; documentation guidance only

enforcedFields.description: Freshness enum. Allowed values from CI1-T4: current, stale, superseded, obsolete, unknown, legacy-current-for-absorption.
ISO date of freshness check. Recommended when freshnessStatus is explicitly checked during the scan.

legalPolicy.note: Vocabulary declared for LPCI-T1 intake. CI2-T3 does not populate legal/policy fields. Population requires a separate LPCI product roadmap after CI1-T7 intake bridge obligations are satisfied.

internalCompany.note: Vocabulary inherited from CI1-T4. Not populated in CI2-T3. Future company-docs corpus wave only.

technicalProject.note: Inherited from CI1-T4. Populated in CI1-T3 scan packet. Not enforced by CI2-T2 checkers.

legacyAbsorption.note: Inherited from CI1-T4. Populated in CI1-T3 scan packet. Not enforced by CI2-T2 checkers.

ci2CheckerBindings.claimBoundary: Structural presence and format gate only. Does not validate hash value accuracy, prove file content integrity, or guarantee drift resistance in production.
ci2CheckerBindings.applicabilityRule: Applies to markdown files under docs/audits/ and docs/reviews/ with docType: audit header or READINESS_PACKET in filename. Explicitly skips docType: review artifacts.

ci2CheckerBindings.claimBoundary: Structural canonical-form gate only. Does not validate path semantic meaning, resolve filesystem path correctness, or guarantee file existence.
ci2CheckerBindings.applicabilityRule: Applies to markdown files under docs/audits/ and docs/reviews/ with docType: audit header or READINESS_PACKET in filename. Explicitly skips docType: review artifacts.

ci2CheckerBindings.claimBoundary: Structural alias discipline gate only. Does not validate semantic correctness of disposition assignments, legal classification, or reviewer judgment.
ci2CheckerBindings.applicabilityRule: Applies to markdown files under docs/audits/ and docs/reviews/ with docType: audit header or READINESS_PACKET in filename. Explicitly skips docType: review artifacts.

t4CompatibilityNote.compatibilityStatement: CI2-T3 supplements CI1-T4 additively. All NR-01 to NR-10 normalization rules from CI1-T4 remain authoritative and are not redefined here. CI2-T3 adds: (1) checker bindings for NR-04, NR-05, NR-11 via ci2CheckerBindings; (2) explicit fieldClass classification for every enforcedFields entry; (3) rawDisposition and dispositionAlias as new NR-11 fields not present in CI1-T4; (4) applicability rules for the three CI2-T2 checkers. The CI1-T4 JSON file is not modified.
t4CompatibilityNote.fieldClassificationNote: Fields classified as structural-required were already required by the CI1-T4 common facet schema but checker-enforcement was absent for most. CI2-T3 records which fields now have checker-backed enforcement versus convention-only or documentation-only discipline.

lpciInputContract.ci2T3Contribution: LPCI-T1 must additionally reference this CI2-T3 enforced model to consume: NR-04/NR-05/NR-11 checker binding contracts, explicit field classification table, rawDisposition and dispositionAlias NR-11 vocabulary, and checker applicability rules.
lpciInputContract.blockingNote: LPCI implementation remains blocked until a separate governed LPCI product roadmap is opened after CI2-T5 closes.

productReadinessBoundary.statement: CI2-T3 produces an enforced field-classification and checker-binding contract. It does NOT build or populate a runtime retrieval index, embedding pipeline, vector database, query execution surface, or LPCI chatbot. It does NOT claim semantic correctness of any classification row, hash value accuracy, or production/hosted readiness.
authorizedUse: product readiness packet field definitions and authoring guidance

claimBoundary: CI2-T3 creates an enforced cross-corpus index model artifact that supplements CI1-T4 with checker bindings, explicit field classification, and NR-11 alias vocabulary. CI1-T4 is not overwritten. CI2-T3 does NOT claim: runtime retrieval index, vector database, embedding pipeline, LPCI chatbot, query behavior proof, semantic correctness of classifications, hash value accuracy, production readiness, hosted readiness, public readiness, or autonomous mutation authority.
